diagnostics.message: module.ctl installs Helm workload addons (aws-load-balancer-controller, aws-node-termination-handler, appmesh-controller, karpenter, cluster-autoscaler, keda) whose pods must run on a cluster with the core networking/DNS addons (vpc-cni, coredns, kube-proxy) that module.eks-addons manages. module.ctl only declares depends_on = [module.base], so it can be applied in parallel with module.eks-addons and fail before those core addons are ready. Its sibling workload-addon modules (module.devops, module.nats) already depend_on module.eks-addons; module.ctl should too (module.base is then pulled in transitively via module.eks-addons).

module.istio deploys Helm workload charts (istio-base, istiod, kiali-server, prometheus) that require the cluster's core networking/DNS addons (vpc-cni, coredns, kube-proxy) managed by module.eks-addons, but module.istio only declares depends_on = [module.base], leaving it unordered with respect to module.eks-addons. module.devops and module.nats already depend on module.eks-addons; module.istio should declare the same dependency (which keeps the module.base ordering transitively).
